title: Twilio Conversation Relay - dtmf message
description: Source: VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handleDtmf, read directly (2026-07-19). Master Roadmap 2026 item #17 fast-follow. A digit with no VoiceDtmfMappingService match is a silent no-op by design (ifPresent, no else branch) - not an error. B4 (voice-safety) owns DTMF ACTIONS; this handler and this schema only cover parsing/menu-routing, not action dispatch.

digit.description: A blank digit is a no-op (handler returns early if digit.isBlank()). Real Twilio DTMF digits are single characters (0-9, *, #) but the handler does not itself constrain length/charset beyond blank-check, so this schema doesn't either - it schemas what the handler enforces, not what Twilio's docs say it will send.
